youtube.title: Why do staples bend *outwards*? 📎 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Staples are designed to bend outwards into a flat clinch to ensure the paper remains held together securely. If they bent inwards, the sharp ends would overlap and create a bulge.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
